full_command: The team reaches a dead end in the subway station, cornered by the ghosts. Dr. Venkman quickly devises a plan, using his knowledge of the supernatural to create a diversion. As the ghosts are momentarily distracted, Dr. Stantz and Dr. Spengler work together to activate their proton packs, while Dana Barrett and Louis Tully help to seal off the area. Walter Peck, disguised as a subway worker, watches from a distance, his face a mix of fear and anger.
